policy: inactive integer kernel (COMMON-AD 87.1; P8 rules.rs class inactive): counts derivative words zero both ways, interfaces untouched

args.name: interfaces
args.reads: word [c][0][nm] (model-top interface pressure, Pa) only; it reaches only the integer count: zero derivative

args.name: counts
args.inactive_reason: Integer wrapper layer count (launch metadata). Piecewise constant in the top pressure, jumps on top = 4(k+1/2) hPa: frozen at the trajectory's value (the forward writes it); derivative words zero.

saved.name: counts
saved.what: the trajectory's layer counts, written by the forward itself and read back by _layer_groups; never recomputed from a perturbed state

branches.rule: NINT on the top pressure: piecewise constant, zero derivative; the count is the trajectory's
integer floor on the extra-layer count (binds when top < 6 hPa): index selection, nothing to freeze

refusal.domain: top/4+0.5 finite and inside int32 (forward (int) defined), nm + n <= INT_MAX, c*2*(nm+1)+nm <= INT_MAX (forward int index)

precondition: interfaces and counts (and their derivative mirrors) do not alias; one thread per column touches only its own count word.
precision: no float derivative arithmetic; the refusal check recomputes the forward's f32 value with its own __fdiv_rn/__fadd_rn order. Built -O3 --fmad=false --ftz=false (live-scheme flags) for uniformity.
piecewise_affine_arms: Constant (zero) map on counts for every executed count value; the tie set top = 4(k+1/2) hPa is measure zero.
